name: SearchTrigger
description: The command search field. A button that looks like a field: it opens the palette.
signature: ({ placeholder: placeholderProp, shortcut, onOpen, className, ...rest }: SearchTriggerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the person clicks the trigger or presses `shortcut` anywhere (unless a palette host already handled the key); open the command palette here.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
